claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Qwen2.5-1.5B did not establish cross-architecture drive-local calibrated eraser steering under the Stage 27P gates; Stage 27O remains a Pythia-family cross-scale result.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Drive-local calibrated output-side eraser-cover steering transfers from Pythia-family models to Qwen2.5-1.5B under Qwen-specific component covers and matched random controls.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim universal cross-architecture steering, complete circuits, exact model-wide causal explanation, durable weight edits, open-ended generation control, or raw CAS-symbol understanding from Stage 27P.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27P is bounded cross-architecture evidence for Qwen drive-local calibrated output-side eraser-cover intervention over CPL2 likelihood margins. It is not universal architecture evidence, not weight editing, not complete circuit discovery, not model-wide control, and not visible free-form generation control.

formal_anchor: Cross-architecture replication of the Stage 27O drive-local calibrated eraser protocol with Qwen-specific component covers, pinned model revision, held-out split, and matched random controls.

gates.criterion: Stage 16 Qwen CPL2 PASS, Stage 27O Pythia-1B PASS, and Stage 27P-A Qwen adapter PASS source contracts are verified.
gates.name: source_contracts

gates.criterion: All seven Foundation drives produce exactly six learned Qwen eraser components from learn rows only.
gates.name: drive_local_cover_contract

gates.criterion: Evaluation uses exactly 56 held-out rows, 8 held-out rows per drive, and no learn/eval overlap.
gates.name: controlled_split

gates.criterion: Qwen drive-local calibrated eraser suppression beats matched random eraser suppression on at least 60% of 56 held-out rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: qwen_drive_local_eval

gates.criterion: Passing Qwen drive-local mode must have positive mean increment and positive increment share at least 55%.
gates.name: positive_effect_floor

method: Commit this pre-registration, runner, and tests before any Stage 27P GPU result is generated.
Verify Stage 16 Qwen CPL2 PASS, Stage 27O Pythia drive-local PASS, and Stage 27P-A Qwen hook-adapter PASS source contracts.
Select 16 CPL2-eligible hard-partner rows per Foundation drive from the Stage 7 fixture using seed 27043.
Split the selected rows into 8 learn rows and 8 held-out eval rows per drive.
Enumerate Qwen output-side candidate components over layers 24-27: every attention head plus one MLP block per layer.
For each Foundation drive, learn a separate Qwen eraser cover on that drive's 8 learn rows only.
For each Foundation drive, choose one eraser scale from the fixed grid by maximum mean margin increment on that drive's learn rows.
Evaluate each drive-local cover only on held-out rows from its matching drive.
Compare held-out increments against matched random covers sampled separately for each drive-local cover.
motivation: Stage 27O showed that drive-local output-side eraser covers solve Pythia-1B cross-scale steering. Stage 27P tests the same drive-local method on Qwen2.5-1.5B after Stage 27P-A validated the Qwen hook adapter.

required_inputs.random_control_policy: each Qwen drive-local eraser cover compared against matched random covers for the same drive and same selected scale
